messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered: PROD inference-service latency > 99thpct threshold (rule: inference.latency.p99 > 1200ms) — page: https://pagerduty/PD12345 :rotating_light:

SRE Oncall: acked — taking

Tom Chen: I'm on it, pulling up grafana and recent deploys

Priya Raman: saw a 30-60s spike across a few regions, looks correlated with small traffic burst from canary jobs

Kai Mendoza: any autoscale activity? could be scale-up latency

SRE Oncall: checking autoscaler logs... here's the relevant snippet:
```
2026-03-15T14:02:01Z autoscaler: scale-up initiated -> 3 -> 6 pods
2026-03-15T14:02:05Z kube: pod start delay avg 12s
2026-03-15T14:02:25Z model-serving: kv-cache miss spike
```

Tom Chen: KV-cache miss spike matches. I'm seeing token-generation latency jump and a bunch of `400` retries from edge routing.

Priya Raman: Dumping recent request traces (short):
```
trace_id: abc123 duration_ms: 1350 model: small-v2 route: hosted-us-east
trace_id: def456 duration_ms: 1480 model: small-v2 route: hosted-us-west
```

PagerDuty: Reminder — escalation to SRE Lead in 2m if not acknowledged.

Kai Mendoza: I pushed a temporary routing fallback to model small-v1 for new requests (lower mem, faster startup) — should reduce tail latency in ~10s.

Tom Chen: Confirming tail latency dropping, p99 back to ~400ms

SRE Oncall: observed recovery, incident-bot reports auto-resolve at 14:04:03Z — but we're seeing brief flapping (3 pages in 5m)

Priya Raman: looks like blend of canary traffic burst and kv-warm cold misses on newly started pods. Need tuning: pre-warm KV cache on scale events and add narrow suppression window to avoid paging for short lived spikes.

Kai Mendoza: Agreed. I'll open a follow-up runbook change and a PR for autoscaler hook to prefetch KV and warm models on scale-up.

Tom Chen: Created ticket: https://jira/REDWOOD-3210 "investigate transient inference p99 flapping — autoscale warmup & alert tuning". Assigning to eng-runtime and eng-sre.

SRE Oncall: passing to next oncall for postmortem notes. tagging @Priya Raman for context. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: thread auto-resolved by system (no current alerts).
